The y-axis tick marks go up to 800, but the axis itself extends to approximately 900 and the data peaks above 800. Stating the range is 'from 0 to 800' is inaccurate.
The line begins at a value visibly higher than the 800 grid line. The reference description correctly identifies it as approximately 850.
The spike around training step 550 does not reach 100. The value 100 would be halfway to the 200 grid line, but the spike is visibly much lower, approximately at 60-70.
